cases_none_published.description: These districts' public/data/cases files have no items (the profile shows a note). The cases lane logs the cause.

fcms_method_sensitive_years_before_curre.description: For FCMS measures affected by the March 2012 change from counting criminal cases to counting defendants, the web series start in FY 2005 (FY 2010 for weighted filings, current case weights). Earlier own-year values exist in the FCMS lane on the old method but are not mixed into these series.
fcms_method_sensitive_years_before_curre.reason: Avoids splicing two counting methods into one series.

judges_counts_national_not_summed.description: No national figure is shown for active or senior judges: judges assigned to two districts are counted in each, so district counts do not add up to a national head count.

no_value_latest_year:active_judges.description: Active judges in office: No data in FY/period 2026 for 3 district(s). The producing lane logs the reason.
no_value_latest_year:active_judges.reason: Not published or not applicable at the source (see the producing lane's gap log).

per_capita_no_national_rate.description: No national per-capita rate is shown: national FCMS and IDB totals include the territorial courts, which have no population estimate, so numerator and denominator would not match.

per_capita_population_approximate.description: Per-capita rates for these five districts use an approximate population: counties split by statute (Yellowstone NP, Fort Bragg / Camp MacKall, FCI Butner) are counted whole in one district. Values are shown with a cell note.

per_capita_territories_no_population.description: Per-capita rates are No data for D. Guam, D.N. Mar. I. and D.V.I.: the Census Bureau publishes no annual population estimates for the Island Areas.

ussc_four_way_grouping_scheme_split.description: The USSC four-way grouping (within, above, government-sponsored below, non-government-sponsored below) is shown as two series: the USSC's printed FY 2006 to 2017 grouping and the same grouping rebuilt from the FY 2018 method for FY 2014 to 2025. Neither exists for FY 1995 to 2005 (before Booker the categories were departures only).
